feedback: Approve. The candidate changes one value from iteration 6, ki 0.05 to 0.10, with kp 2.4, kd 0.8, base_speed 1.2 and all geometry unchanged. That makes it a clean test of the integral term against a raced baseline (iteration 6, 679.10). Slalom max_error has stayed between 0.0618 and 0.0646 across every controller tried (iterations 3 to 6), and the slalom has never finished, so a bias-removing integral term is the untested lever with the most upside. The change is small and the windup risk is low: the integral is capped at plus or minus 2, so ki 0.1 adds at most about 0.2 to the turn term. The candidate is not expected to beat the best raced design (iteration 5, 699.16). Its value is information: it tests whether a slalom finish is reachable. Oval and s-bend have been stable at 20/20 and 19 to 20/20 across these controllers, so the score is not at risk from this one change. Iterations 0 to 6 show that geometry changes (sensor y shift, mass, wider x coverage) moved line losses, while controller changes have not moved slalom max_error below 0.06. After the race, read the result by track. If the slalom still ends off track with max_error at or above 0.06, the integral does not solve the slalom problem. If the oval or s-bend finish rate drops below 0.95, ki 0.1 is causing windup or oscillation. If any slalom run finishes, hold the controller and geometry fixed and confirm.
requested_changes: If the oval or s-bend finish rate drops below 0.95, or steering_oscillation rises above about 0.3, set ki back to 0.05. Iteration 6 (ki 0.05, kp 2.4, kd 0.8) had oval 20/20 and s-bend 20/20, so that is the reference.

If the slalom still ends off track with max_error at or above 0.06 and line_loss_events at or above 1.0, return to the best-scoring controller (kp 2.6, kd 0.9, ki 0.05, iteration 5, 699.16). Then try widening sensor coverage to x of plus or minus 0.04 m (five sensors at -0.04, -0.02, 0, 0.02, 0.04) with y 0.06 kept. Iteration 1 showed that wider x coverage cut s-bend line losses from 2.05 to 1.15, and slalom losses from 1.75 to 1.05.
If any slalom run finishes, hold ki 0.1, kp 2.4, kd 0.8, base_speed 1.2 and all geometry fixed, and use the next race to confirm the score rather than change gains.
